gap: No result ChatGPT got states that on Synology's 2025 Plus models (DS925+, DS725+, DS425+) an M.2 storage pool needs Synology-verified SSDs, and that the DS225+ has no M.2 slot at all. So the 'SSD volume for PostgreSQL' layout ChatGPT recommended in every answer means buying a Synology SSD, or giving up one of the two drive bays on the DS225+.
standout_why: Compared against the pages ChatGPT cited: the Paperless-ngx Setup, Configuration and FAQ pages, setup.md on GitHub, and (uncited) andreaswaelchli.com's Synology install guide. None says anything about M.2 or SSD limits on any NAS. The Wälchli guide puts Postgres on /volume1 and never says what kind of drive is behind it. racksandwatts.com (rank 9/18, not cited) has part of this: a general line that 'new M.2 storage pools and SSD cache require drives on the compatibility list', and DS225+ listed as '2 SATA, no NVMe'. It does not use the word 'verified', does not mention the DS725+, and does not connect any of this to Paperless or the database-on-SSD advice. ChatGPT's own answers recommended an SSD for the database on the DS725+, DS925+ and DS225+, and the only warning they gave was 'check drive compatibility'.
decides: This keeps UGREEN DXP2800 as the value pick. On Synology, the SSD-for-database layout costs extra: on the DS925+, DS725+ and DS425+ the M.2 pool has to use a Synology-verified SSD, and on the DS225+ the SSD takes one of the two bays, which leaves no HDD mirror. Synology still makes sense for someone who wants DSM and either buys Synology's SSD or keeps Postgres on the HDD mirror, which is fine for a personal archive. The QNAP TS-264's M.2 slots are only PCIe Gen 3 x1. The Asustor one-click package is x86-64 only, and its PostgreSQL build is the last one, so upgrading to the later MariaDB builds means exporting your data first.

findings.label: Paperless-ngx App Central package
findings.value: Paperless-ngx 3.2.1.r01, updated 2026-09-30, x86-64 only, requires ADM 4.3.0+, PostgreSQL backend; supported series include AS54 (AS5402T)
findings.note: The page says 'This is the last version for using PostgreSQL'. Later builds move to MariaDB on ADM 5.0, so you must export your data before upgrading. Office-file import needs ADM 5.0+ and the Apache Tika app 3.3.1.0.

findings.label: Official Paperless-ngx compose images and Postgres mount path
findings.value: postgres:18 with volume pgdata:/var/lib/postgresql; valkey/valkey:9-alpine broker; ghcr.io/paperless-ngx/paperless-ngx:latest
findings.note: Postgres 18 mounts /var/lib/postgresql, not /var/lib/postgresql/data. Older NAS guides that bind-mount the /data path don't match this file.
